posts.en:
deepseek-harness-zh_pro is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Chinese UI enhancement for the DSH web client: completes the Chinese locale, keeps the session stats line fully visible on one row, and adds an Enhancements settings section with configurable chat width.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-633daeb9165a5ff36bb6.html
